verdict.rationale: Jules exposes an API for creating custom workflows and automating many tasks (bug fixes, code reviews) across repos, and usage-limit tiers explicitly target 'agent-heavy workflows' with high task counts (up to 300/day), while a community user reports it 'handles large quantities of tasks very well'. However, there's no documented dedicated bulk/batch endpoint or UI for operating on many items simultaneously—support is inferred from API automation and volume limits rather than an explicit bulk-operations feature. missing for 10: a documented batch/bulk API endpoint or UI, first-party examples of running bulk operations across many items, independent hands-on verification of true bulk/batch execution.
